relevant_laws.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Walk” indication or walking person symbol is illuminated, pedestrians facing the signal may proceed across the highway in the direction of the signal and must be given the right-of-way by the drivers of all vehicles.
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen Walk/crosswalk witness; official display, governing direction and cited exceptions need original review.
